identity: ONE original small goblin-like marsh creature, the Sporelamp Tosser, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the broad spotted golden-tan mushroom-cap hood with ragged leaf-shaped edges, the dark green-skinned face with a pointed ear, the olive leaf-tattered tunic and baggy trousers, the brown leather boots, and the leather satchel at the hip full of small glowing teal spore orbs and amber bulbs. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. The screen-LEFT hand holds ONE glowing teal glass spore orb; the screen-RIGHT hand holds a short sling strap with ONE glowing amber bulb lamp. Preserve the mushroom hood, the satchel of orbs, the sling lamp and the small hunched proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the whole hood, both hands with the orb and the sling lamp, the satchel and both boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, spore clouds, smoke, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra limbs; glow stays only inside the orbs and the amber bulbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support.

idle_h3_v1.action: A twitchy, mischievous idle that loops. The creature breathes, bobs on its bent knees, tosses the spore orb lightly in the hand and catches it, swings the sling lamp a little and turns the hooded head to peer around, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no throwing.

move_h3_v1.action: Scurry in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with quick short steps. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The body stays centred for engine-driven travel, hunched forward, the orb held up and the sling lamp swinging. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE orb jab toward screen right. The creature draws the hand with the spore orb back to the chest as the knees bend, then lunges forward and thrusts the orb out to full reach at screen right, still holding it, pulls it back and settles into the original stance. One jab only; the orb never breaks and no spores appear.

ranged_h3_v1.action: Throw ONE spore orb toward screen right. The creature raises the orb high behind the hooded head, then steps forward and whips the arm through overhand toward screen right; at the release the hand opens and the orb is gone at once, never shown in flight. The creature takes a new orb from the satchel and settles into the original stance. One throw only; no spores, smoke or trail.

hit_h3_v1.action: The creature reels from an unseen blow and recovers completely. The hooded head snaps back, the arms fly out and the knees buckle while both hands keep hold of the orb and the sling, then the creature steadies on both boots and returns to the same stance. Nothing is seen hitting it: no projectile, spark or flash. The blue background never flashes or changes colour.

defend_h3_v1.action: Crouch low and duck under the broad mushroom hood, hugging the satchel and the orb close to the chest, then hold the hunched cover on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the upright stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A lamp signal. The creature raises the sling lamp high overhead and swings it in a small circle while the amber bulb glows a little brighter, holds the pose briefly, then lowers it back to the original stance. Only the bulb brightens; no spores, beam or spell effect.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly. The creature staggers and sits down hard on the ground, stays there a moment, then slumps over and lies flat on its side with the mushroom hood at screen right, the satchel spilled open and the orbs and lamp lying dim beside it, finishing motionless. The body never leaves the ground; no spore cloud, no recovery and no disappearing body.
